run_wiki_split_main: run the main function to generate k-shot data for the WikiSplit dataset with multiple seeds
create_wiki_split_dataset: create a WikiSplit dataset instance to load and process the HuggingFace wiki_split dataset
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of sentence pairs for text-to-text tasks
load_wiki_split_dataset: load the wiki_split dataset from HuggingFace using the datasets library
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot training, dev, and test splits from the WikiSplit dataset with a given seed
